title: Physical Realizability of Quantum Computation
exact_target: Determine whether scalable physical systems can feasibly implement the standard quantum-computation model.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001373 (OWR-4135-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

fault-tolerant quantum computation theorem; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: This is the workshop introduction's foundational physical question. No universal engineering-resource budget, device class, or noise law is supplied. Evidence for hardness of classical simulation is not a proof of scalable physical realizability, and fault-tolerance assumptions cannot be silently treated as established experimental facts.
